sentiment.label: Mixed
sentiment.summary: As of about 10:05am ET no first trade had been reported, so the mood still rests on pre-listing coverage: strong demand for the record deal against questions over valuation and a possibly late opening auction.
points: Anthropic priced at $83, above the $70-78 range, raising $81.3bn in what CNBC and NPR describe as the largest IPO on record
Stock Titan's live page noted 'no trade yet' at 9:35am ET; Fast Company warned trading may begin well after the bell
Khaleej Times reports expected inclusion in several major indexes within weeks, and that SpaceX's debut is seen as a pricing template
Investinglive, citing the WSJ, said some investors had pushed for a lower valuation after a tech selloff

updates.text: Khaleej Times reports that Anthropic is expected to join at least six major indexes, including the Nasdaq 100, within 5 to 15 days of listing, and that a separate $26 billion private sale with cornerstone investors is also planned.

Anthropic prices its IPO at $83 a share, above the $70–78 range, selling 980 million shares and raising $81.3 billion. Trading on Nasdaq under ANT is expected from 9:30am New York time on 19 November.
